item.title: Durbin says Trump left a ‘mess’ after Supreme Court blocks tariff policy
item.description: Illinois Senator Dick Durbin (D) says President Trump has left a "mess" after he says economists warned him his tariff policy was unconstitutional. In a 6-3 decision, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled that President Trump did not have emergency authority to enact tariffs without the approval of Congress. item.description: A family-owned record store in Chicago's Beverly neighborhood is facing another setback. item.title: Chicago weather: Breezy conditions continue with light snow chances
item.description: Gusty winds that reached 40 to 50 mph earlier in the day eased Friday evening, though breezy conditions persisted across the Chicago area.Temperatures fell to 27 degrees at O’Hare International Airport, with sustained winds around 16 mph and higher gusts making it feel closer to 15 degrees. Midway Airport reported 28 degrees, with similar readings along the lakefront and in Waukegan.
